newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 17 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 17 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Co. said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 17 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Mesa Unified School District No. 4, Ariz., $29.150 million school improvement bonds.
--Vallejo City USD, Calif., $30 million GO bonds.
--Baltimore, Md., $8.745 million public improvement (tax) bonds and $26.625 million public improvement bonds.
--Cumberland County, N.J., $500,000 college bonds, $675,000 school bonds and $2.932 million general improvement bonds.
--Washingtonville CSD, N.Y., $2.344 million school district bonds.
--Ohio, $50 million natural resources GOs and $125 million hihgway GOs.
--Dorchester County SD, S.C., $7.4 million school building.
--Port Houston Auth., Texas, $28 million port improvement bonds.
--Eagle Lake, Texas, $1 million certificates of obligation bonds.
--Milwaukee, Wis, $34.145 million corporate purpose bonds and $4.525 million corporate purpose (tax) bonds.
